text: {"label":"Substance Use Treatment and Behavioral Economics","definition":"Applied and translational work on human addiction, including smoking and other drug use, through contingency management and voucher incentives, behavioral economic measures of severity, choice theories, and treatment dissemination.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on treating and measuring human substance use, unlike animal drug self-administration and relapse studies, general behavioral pharmacology of medications, or broad behavioral intervention programs."}
